reviewer: French authoring agent; independent cross-check of Spanish sidecars

sampling.interior60: index(j) = 30 + floor(j * (N - 61) / 59), j = 0..59; evenly spaced across the interior to avoid overlap

checks: German, French, Japanese and Chinese translations where present
Selected meaning and part of speech after correction overrides
Explicit focus span and inferred Cloze focus

summary.verdict: Address the listed findings before presenting the sampled rows as checked. This is not native review or approval of the full corpus.

validation.jsonAndSchema: 120 examples and all six corresponding corrections passed validateExampleRecord / validateCorrection
validation.focus: findSentenceFocus resolved 119 of 120; tratar/trata requires the explicit span suggested above

findings.title: Correct the Korean gloss of no
findings.problem: The Korean gloss says the action cannot be performed, importing inability from the Korean source. Spanish no expresses negation; inability in the example comes from puedo, not no. The sentence and its translations are correct.

correction.meaningEn: not; used to negate an action or statement
correction.meaningKo: 아니, 않다; 행동이나 진술을 부정할 때 쓰는 말

meanings.de: nicht; verneint eine Handlung oder Aussage
meanings.fr: ne… pas ; sert à nier une action ou une affirmation
meanings.ja: 〜ない；動作や内容を否定する語
meanings.zh: 不；用于否定行为或陈述

correction.reason: Remove inability from the definition of the general Spanish negation word.

findings.title: Capitalise Estado in the sovereign-state sense
findings.problem: The selected sense is a sovereign political state. RAE marks these senses of Estado with an initial capital. The current example uses lowercase estado.

example.text: El Estado mantiene relaciones diplomáticas con sus vecinos.

findings.title: Distinguish Gobierno from all branches of the State
findings.problem: The inherited gloss combines legislature, judiciary and executive, which describes Estado rather than the ordinary institutional Gobierno sense used in the example. This institutional sense also takes an initial capital.

example.text: Los ciudadanos piden más transparencia al Gobierno.

correction.meaningEn: government; the body directing the executive affairs of a state or political community
correction.meaningKo: 정부; 국가나 정치 공동체의 행정과 정책을 이끄는 집행 기관

meanings.fr: gouvernement ; organe dirigeant du pouvoir exécutif
meanings.ja: 政府；行政を指揮する機関
meanings.zh: 政府；领导行政事务的机构

correction.reason: Distinguish the executive government from the State as a whole.

findings.title: Remove the age restriction from sí
findings.problem: The definition restricts sí to answering an elder. Spanish affirmative or acknowledgement replies are not intrinsically honorific or restricted by age. The teacher dialogue is valid, but it should not teach that restriction. This finding does not request a POS change; the project may retain its interjection taxonomy for the independent reply.

correction.meaningEn: yes; an affirmative or acknowledging reply
correction.meaningKo: 네, 응; 긍정하거나 부름에 응답하는 말

meanings.fr: oui ; réponse affirmative ou marquant que l’on a entendu
meanings.ja: はい、うん；肯定や呼びかけへの返答
meanings.zh: 是，嗯；用于肯定或回应呼唤

correction.reason: Remove Korean-specific age or honorific restrictions from the Spanish reply.

findings.title: Supply the inflected focus trata
findings.problem: The lemma is tratar, but the sentence contains trata and has no explicit focus. The actual findSentenceFocus function returns null, so this otherwise correct example is omitted from Cloze.

findings.title: Make gastar an active spending verb
findings.problem: The inherited English and Korean glosses describe resources being used, while the target sentence correctly uses gastar transitively with people spending the budget. The passive source wording obscures the required argument structure.

correction.meaningEn: to spend money, time or other resources on something

meanings.de: Geld, Zeit oder andere Mittel für etwas ausgeben oder aufwenden
meanings.fr: dépenser de l’argent ou consacrer du temps ou des ressources à quelque chose
meanings.ja: お金や時間などの資源を使う
meanings.zh: 花费金钱、时间或其他资源

correction.reason: Align the definition with the active transitive spending sense.

findings.title: Keep uncertainty separate from established job instability
findings.problem: The Spanish says uncertainty about her employment prevented planning. Korean 일자리가 불안정해서 asserts that the job itself was unstable, and 계획을 세우기 어려웠어요 weakens prevention to difficulty. Other translations retain the uncertainty.

example.ko: 일자리에 대한 불안 때문에 그 사람은 계획을 세울 수 없었어요.

findings.title: Attach youth to the grandmother unambiguously
findings.problem: 그 사람의 젊은 시절 할머니 모습 has an awkward modifier chain that can place the youth in the portrait owner’s life rather than the grandmother’s. The Spanish explicitly depicts the grandmother when young.

example.ko: 그 초상화에는 그 사람의 할머니가 젊었을 때의 모습이 그려져 있어요.

limits: This deterministic sample covers 120 of 1759 examples, not the complete Spanish corpus. It is not a random statistical sample and does not support an overall error-rate estimate.
Only six of 150 correction rows fall within the example sample; all other corrections remain unreviewed here.

55 sampled examples contain the additional de/fr/ja/zh translations; the remaining 65 were reviewed only in es/en/ko. Missing translations are an acknowledged coverage backlog, not counted as editorial defects in this report.
No audio, rendered UI, broader dialect consistency or exhaustive dictionary fact audit was performed.
All judgments are AI editorial judgments; native-speaker and specialist review remain pending.
Changes above are exact suggestions, not applied edits. Corrected sense definitions must be reviewed before reusing source concept mappings.
resolution: All eight findings applied to authoring/correction records; sampled AI editorial checking only.
